Jamal: Handoff — starting nightwatch. We're tracking a regen-fanout alert hitting authz-proxy in us-west-2. Paging still sporadic. root ts=4201234567
Priya: ack — what's the current customer impact?
Jamal: Roughly 3% of generation starts returning 5xx; retries are inflating token usage for some clients. Embeddings paths unaffected.
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: authz-proxy regen-fanout spike — 5xx surge detected (12 alerts). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/4201
Mike: Mitigations in flight: applied edge rate-shed to low-priority routes, mapped 502->429 temporarily to break regen loops. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/ops/authz-regen-runbook
Priya: concrete steps performed so far?
Jamal: Summary: 1) scaled authz-proxy +2 replicas in us-west-2; 2) flipped feature flag to disable client retry on model-init path; 3) applied iptables rule to throttle noisy client CIDR ranges; 4) queued rolling restart for authz v1.3.1 warmfix (canary stage); 5) shifted heavy-customer traffic to us-east fallback pool.
Mike: Early metrics: 429s up, overall token emission down ~18%; p99 latency for authz check improved from ~1.2s -> ~0.9s on affected path.
Priya: Open tasks for next shift: - Monitor error-rate and retry churn; if errors >5% escalate to SEV2 - Continue warmfix canary ramps (10% -> 30% -> 100%) - Re-enable client retries only after stability window - Postmortem owner? (Jamal suggested)
Jamal: I'll own the postmortem. Contacts: @Jamal, @Priya, @Mike. For tonight's coverage: primary = Priya (18:00-02:00 PT), secondary = Mike.
OncallBot: /shift-change recorded — new primary: Priya, secondary: Mike (see shift log)
Jamal: Known customer impacts: customer-acme observed increased latency and 5xxs; sample request ids in logs: abc123, def456. Support ticket created: https://support.redwood/ticket/4789
Priya: I'll ping SEs if a paying customer sees >10% error rate or sustained retries.
Mike: Runbook snippet pasted here for quick reference:
```
if regen-loop:
  - apply edge rate-shed (low-priority routes)
  - map 502->429 to prevent client retry storms
  - disable client retry on model-init
  - scale authz-proxy +2 replicas
  - canary warmfix rollout 10%->30%->100%
```
Jamal: Action items for next shift (short): - Continue warmfix canary, annotate any failed canary pods with logs - Keep edge rate-shed until token churn stabilizes - Rotate logs nightly to avoid disk pressure - Watch kv-cache eviction metrics (small bump observed)
Priya: Any outstanding blockers?
Jamal: Warmfix image failing on one canary pod due to cert reload error in logs. Workaround: manual pod restart for now; canary still at 20%. Investigating cert reload path with infra if it persists.
Priya: Noted — I'll escalate to eng-infra if cert failures continue after one more restart.
Jamal: Dashboards/links I left: https://grafana.redwood/d/authz, https://logs.redwood/explore?query=authz-proxy, runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/authz-regen-runbook
Priya: I'll do hourly check-ins unless things quiet down. Will post a short update at xx:00 PT. :thumbsup:
Mike: If pagers exceed 3 in 10m, escalate to eng-sre and page oncall@redwood.
Priya: Acknowledged. Taking primary now, signing over. Good luck — keep me posted on any regressions. :rocket:
